fire-stone.name: Fire Stone
fire-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a fiery orange heart.

water-stone.name: Water Stone
water-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear, light blue.

thunder-stone.name: Thunder Stone
thunder-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a distinct thunderbolt pattern.

leaf-stone.name: Leaf Stone
leaf-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern.

moon-stone.name: Moon Stone
moon-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

sun-stone.name: Sun Stone
sun-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It burns red like the evening sun.

shiny-stone.name: Shiny Stone
shiny-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

dusk-stone.name: Dusk Stone
dusk-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It holds a dark shadow.

dawn-stone.name: Dawn Stone
dawn-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It sparkles like a glittering eye.

ice-stone.name: Ice Stone
ice-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a snowflake pattern.

kings-rock.name: King's Rock
kings-rock.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When held, it may cause the target to flinch upon taking damage.

metal-coat.name: Metal Coat
metal-coat.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a special metallic film that boosts Steel-type moves.

dragon-scale.name: Dragon Scale
dragon-scale.description: A thick, tough scale. Dragon-type Pokémon may be holding it.

up-grade.name: Upgrade
up-grade.description: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It was produced by Silph Co.

dubious-disc.name: Dubious Disc
dubious-disc.description: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.

protector.name: Protector
protector.description: A protective item. It is extremely stiff and heavy.

electirizer.name: Electirizer
electirizer.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy.

magmarizer.name: Magmarizer
magmarizer.description: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy.

reaper-cloth.name: Reaper Cloth
reaper-cloth.description: A cloth imbued with terrible spiritual energy.

deep-sea-tooth.name: Deep Sea Tooth
deep-sea-tooth.description: A tooth that glints a sharp silver. It raises Special Attack when held by Clamperl.

deep-sea-scale.name: Deep Sea Scale
deep-sea-scale.description: A scale that shines a faint pink. It raises Special Defense when held by Clamperl.

prism-scale.name: Prism Scale
prism-scale.description: A mysterious scale that shines in rainbow colors. It causes certain Pokémon to evolve.

oval-stone.name: Oval Stone
oval-stone.description: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's shaped like an egg.

sachet.name: Sachet
sachet.description: A sachet filled with fragrant sachet powder that exhales a faint perfume.

whipped-dream.name: Whipped Dream
whipped-dream.description: A soft and sweet treat made of fluffy whipped cream.

razor-claw.name: Razor Claw
razor-claw.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that boosts critical-hit ratio.

razor-fang.name: Razor Fang
razor-fang.description: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may cause the target to flinch on attack.

sweet-apple.name: Sweet Apple
sweet-apple.description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is exceptionally sweet.

tart-apple.name: Tart Apple
tart-apple.description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is exceptionally tart.

syrupy-apple.name: Syrupy Apple
syrupy-apple.description: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is covered in sweet syrup.

chipped-pot.name: Chipped Pot
chipped-pot.description: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a chip on it.

cracked-pot.name: Cracked Pot
cracked-pot.description: A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a crack in it.

unremarkable-teacup.name: Unremarkable Teacup
unremarkable-teacup.description: A peculiar teacup that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is quite plain.

masterpiece-teacup.name: Masterpiece Teacup
masterpiece-teacup.description: A peculiar teacup that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a masterpiece.

galarica-cuff.name: Galarica Cuff
galarica-cuff.description: A cuff made from woven Galarica Twigs that can make a Galarian Slowpoke evolve.

galarica-wreath.name: Galarica Wreath
galarica-wreath.description: A wreath made from woven Galarica Twigs that can make a Galarian Slowpoke evolve.

black-augurite.name: Black Augurite
black-augurite.description: A glass-like black stone that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve.

peat-block.name: Peat Block
peat-block.description: A block of muddy peat that can make Ursaring evolve during a full moon.

auspicious-armor.name: Auspicious Armor
auspicious-armor.description: A peculiar suit of armor that can make Charcadet evolve into Armarouge.

malicious-armor.name: Malicious Armor
malicious-armor.description: A peculiar suit of armor that can make Charcadet evolve into Ceruledge.

scroll-of-darkness.name: Scroll of Darkness
scroll-of-darkness.description: A secret scroll that can make Kubfu evolve into Single Strike Style Urshifu.

scroll-of-waters.name: Scroll of Waters
scroll-of-waters.description: A secret scroll that can make Kubfu evolve into Rapid Strike Style Urshifu.
